data.exact_reserve_text: During 2016, net ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2014 & prior) reduced by GBP 6.7m. This was mainly due to favourable claims development over the year in the Director's & Officers, Marine Liability and Aerospace classes. The Airline Liability class also benefited from a GBP 2.7m takedown in the large 2008 Air France loss. These reductions were offset by net ultimate claims increases in the A&H and General Liability classes, partly due to increased exposure estimates as inwards premium from binders were revised upwards.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the Syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 411.418m. Using the gross claims development triangle, the Syndicate shows net favourable development on prior underwriting years (2014 and earlier), with a calculated gross release of approximately GBP 11.95m (c.2.9% of opening gross claims). The reported net release was GBP 6.7m, driven by favourable development in Directors & Officers, Marine Liability and Aerospace, and a GBP 2.7m takedown on the large 2008 Air France loss, partially offset by adverse movements in Accident & Health and General Liability due to exposure increases from binders.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was not provided explicitly as a single gross figure. The gross PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for UW years 2011-2014 and summing the changes (calculated figure -11.948m). The report explicitly states the net PYD (-6.7m); net and gross therefore differ (reinsurance movements). Confidence in the gross triangle extraction is high, but note that the reconciliation table 'movement in provision' includes current year movements and was not used. Some named event years were not provided and are set to null where unknown.
